name: worker_base_url
label: Event Engine worker base URL
help_text: Leave blank to inherit the theme-wide setting at Design Manager → Theme settings → Integrations, which selects the Worker. Keep that on `Production`, which is event-engine.refuel-creative.workers.dev. The Worker formerly deployed as event-engine-staging was RENAMED to it and that hostname no longer resolves, so do not put it back. A value here overrides it for this module only. Note: only used with a server-minted corporate_action_token for authenticated Worker-direct writes. Unauthenticated browser calls to this Worker are not supported — prefer the same-origin /_hcms/api/corporate serverless handlers.
